issue_context.title: Missing option  to disable fallback to legacy mode auth
issue_context.body:
### The problem


"2024-04-15 09:14:33.619 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.auth.providers.homeassistant] Home Assistant auth provider is running in legacy mode because we detected usernames that are case-insensitiveequivalent. Please change the username: 'user'."  

Note: Typo: case-insensitiveequivalent => case-insensitive equivalent

We need an option to disable this behaviour since it ist often not waranted and pollutes the log with warnings. You can't just change usernames or their display name. They are usually intentional and thus a fallback to the legacy auth system is not waranted.
If there is a technical reason for case-insensitive equivalent not being possible in the non-legacy auth system then I would recommend an review of this arbitrary limit and classifying it as a issue itself.

Related: #84263 #97613

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2024.4.3
